RegionFed：异构零售环境中个性化查询理解的联合学习RegionFed: Federated Learning for Personalized Query Understanding in Heterogeneous Retail Environments

Quoc H. Nguyen ††thanks: Use footnote for providing further information about author (webpage, alternative address)—not for acknowledging funding agencies. Affiliation: Walmart Global Tech Affiliation: Sunnyvale Affiliation: California, USA, Email: quoc.nguyen@walmart.com    Ali Lafzi Affiliation: Walmart Global Tech Affiliation: Sunnyvale Affiliation: California, USA,    Abhijeet Phatak Affiliation: Walmart Global Tech Affiliation: Sunnyvale Affiliation: California, USA,    Siddharth Pratap Singh Affiliation: Walmart Global Tech Affiliation: Sunnyvale Affiliation: California, USA,    Rohit Upadhyay Affiliation: Walmart Global Tech Affiliation: Sunnyvale Affiliation: California, USA,    Yogananda Domlur Seetharama Affiliation: Walmart Global Tech Affiliation: Sunnyvale Affiliation: California, USA,    Chittaranjan Tripathy Affiliation: Walmart Global Tech Affiliation: Sunnyvale Affiliation: California, USA,
摘要Abstract

零售搜索系统服务于具有不同查询模式、词汇和产品偏好的不同地理区域，从而产生显着的数据异质性，这对隐私保护培训和模型个性化提出了挑战。联邦学习为隐私提供了一种自然的解决方案，但标准 FL 方法产生的全局模型会牺牲区域性能，而现有的个性化 FL 方法在参数级别运行，并由于绑定嵌入和 LayerNorm 交互而在现代 Transformer 上灾难性地崩溃（T5 上的精度低于 10%）。我们介绍 RegionFed，Retail search systems serve diverse geographic regions with distinct query patterns, vocabularies, and product preferences, creating significant data heterogeneity that challenges both privacy-preserving training and model personalization. Federated learning offers a natural solution for privacy, but standard FL methods produce global models that sacrifice regional performance, while existing personalized FL approaches operate at the parameter level and catastrophically collapse on modern transformers (below 10% accuracy on T5) due to tied embeddings and LayerNorm interactions. We introduce RegionFed, an架构稳健architecture-robust联邦学习框架通过完全在梯度水平上运行来避免这种失败。 RegionFed 使用federated learning framework that sidesteps this failure by operating entirely at the gradient level. RegionFed uses theℓ2\ell_{2}将区域和全球梯度之间的冲突作为统一信号，（i）诊断异质性，（ii）将每个区域路由到最便宜的足够个性化策略，以及（iii）自适应控制个性化强度。由于 RegionFed 将模型视为可微分的黑匣子，因此可以在 T5-Small、T5-3B、RoBERTa 和 CNN 上进行零代码更改的部署，为 Transformer 带来巨大收益（其中参数级方法崩溃），并对 CNN 进行持续改进。在三个公共数据集（Amazon ESCI、Amazon Reviews、LEAF-FEMNIST）和四种架构中，RegionFed-Meta 达到了 92.27%，缩小了与侵犯隐私的中心化上限的差距（中心化 + 区域权重：92.04%，conflict between regional and global gradients as a unified signal that (i) diagnoses heterogeneity, (ii) routes each region to the cheapest sufficient personalization strategy, and (iii) adaptively controls personalization strength. Because it treats models as differentiable black boxes, RegionFed deploys on T5-Small, T5-3B, RoBERTa, and CNN with zero code changes, providing large gains on transformers (where parameter-level methods collapse) and consistent improvements on CNNs. Across three public datasets (Amazon ESCI, Amazon Reviews, LEAF-FEMNIST) and four architectures, RegionFed-Meta achieves 92.27%, closing the gap to the privacy-violating centralized upper bound (Centralized + Regional Weighting: 92.04%,Δ\Delta=0.23pp，1以内=0.23pp, within 1σ\sigma）同时提供) while providing(ϵ≈0.60)(\epsilon{\approx}0.60)- 差异化隐私和-differential privacy and𝒪⁡(1/T)\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})收敛。convergence.

1 简介Introduction

大型零售平台为不同地理区域的数亿客户提供服务，每个客户都有不同的购物行为、词汇和产品偏好。用户体验的一个关键组成部分是搜索系统准确解释查询并将其置于上下文中的能力。然而，这造成了根本性的紧张：有效的个性化需要了解区域模式，而隐私法规（GDPR、CCPA）和数据主权问题则禁止集中敏感查询数据。联邦学习（FL）Large-scale retail platforms serve hundreds of millions of customers across diverse geographical regions, each with distinct shopping behaviors, vocabularies, and product preferences. A critical component of the user experience is the search system’s ability to accurately interpret and contextualize queries. Yet this creates a fundamental tension: effective personalization requires understanding regional patterns, while privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) and data sovereignty concerns prohibit centralizing sensitive query data. Federated learning (FL)(McMahan et al., 2017)为保护隐私的分布式训练提供了一种自然的范例，但是在异构零售环境中部署 FL 会带来现有方法（包括最近的集群方法）面临的挑战。offers a natural paradigm for privacy-preserving distributed training, but deploying FL in heterogeneous retail environments introduces challenges that existing methods, including recent clustered(Ghosh et al., 2020; Sattler et al., 2021)和个性化的方法and personalized approaches(T. Dinh et al., 2020; Tan et al., 2022)，未能完全解决。, fail to fully address.

核心挑战是双重的。The core challenge is twofold.第一First，标准 FL 方法（FedAvg, standard FL methods (FedAvg(McMahan et al., 2017), FedProx (Li et al., 2020)）产生一个忽略地区异质性的单一全球模型：当“丁字裤”在澳大利亚意味着鞋类但在美国意味着内衣时，全球模型不可避免地会损害某些地区的准确性。) produce a single global model that ignores regional heterogeneity: when “thongs” means footwear in Australia but undergarments in the US, a global model inevitably compromises accuracy for some regions.第二Second，现有的个性化 FL 方法通过控制变量或双层优化在参数级别运行；虽然这些在界面上与架构无关，但它们是, existing personalized FL methods operate at the parameter level through control variates or bi-level optimization; while these are architecture-agnostic in interface, they are对参数景观拓扑敏感sensitive to parameter landscape topology由于共享嵌入、注意力耦合和 LayerNorm 交互，在现代 Transformer 架构上变得不稳定。参数级方法，如 SCAFFOLDand become unstable on modern transformer architectures due to shared embeddings, attention coupling, and LayerNorm interactions. Parameter-level methods like SCAFFOLD(Karimireddy et al., 2020)和 pFedMeand pFedMe(T. Dinh et al., 2020)在 CNN 上取得了很好的成果，但在高维变压器景观上却很困难（详细分析见附录achieved strong results on CNNs but struggle on high-dimensional transformer landscapes (detailed analysis in AppendixF）。最近的方法包括 FedProto). Recent methods including FedProto(Tan et al., 2022)和 pFedHyperand pFedHyper(Zhang et al., 2024)推进个性化，但保留参数级别，继承了类似的限制。这限制了现有个性化 FL 在越来越依赖基于变压器的模型的生产系统中的适用性。advance personalization but remain parameter-level, inheriting similar limitations. This limits the applicability of existing personalized FL to production systems that increasingly rely on transformer-based models.

这一观察激发了我们的关键见解：This observation motivates our key insight:有效的个性化应该在梯度级别而不是参数级别上运行effective personalization should operate at the gradient level rather than the parameter level。通过将模型视为黑盒函数逼近器并基于梯度冲突进行个性化，我们可以实现跨模型系列无缝工作的架构稳健的个性化。我们个性化. By treating models as black-box function approximators and personalizing based on gradient conflicts, we can achieve architecture-robust personalization that works seamlessly across model families. We personalize at the地区region水平而不是个人用户水平，因为区域汇集了足够的客户以产生稳定的梯度估计，并且同一区域内的用户共享系统模式（词汇、产品组合、季节性行为），而具有稀缺数据的每个客户模型无法捕获这些模式。level rather than the individual user level because regions pool enough clients to yield stable gradient estimates, and users within the same region share systematic patterns (vocabulary, product mix, seasonal behavior) that per-client models with scarce data cannot capture.

我们引入了 RegionFed，这是一种用于零售查询理解的梯度级联邦学习框架，可以跨模型架构无缝运行。与之前的工作不同We introduce RegionFed, a gradient-level federated learning framework for retail query understanding that operates seamlessly across model architectures. Unlike prior work(Arivazhagan et al., 2019)RegionFed 需要固定的个性化策略，通过梯度冲突分析动态确定最佳个性化，自动调整区域适应而不损害隐私。而梯度投影requiring fixed personalization strategies, RegionFed dynamically determines optimal personalization through gradient conflict analysis, automatically adjusting regional adaptation without compromising privacy. While gradient projection(Yu et al., 2020)和层次聚合and hierarchical aggregation(Ghosh et al., 2020)独立存在，RegionFed 提供了exist independently, RegionFed provides a原则性组合principled combination：梯度冲突在分层区域结构中充当异质性诊断和自适应控制信号，从而在统一框架中实现计算感知路由和 DP 兼容的个性化。我们的贡献是： (1): gradient conflict serves as both the heterogeneity diagnostic and the adaptive control signal within a hierarchical regional structure, enabling compute-aware routing and DP-compatible personalization in a unified framework. Our contributions are: (1)用于架构稳健个性化的梯度冲突框架Gradient-conflict framework for architecture-robust personalization：RegionFed 不是直接操作模型参数（由于绑定嵌入和 LayerNorm 反馈循环，这在 Transformer 上失败），而是使用: rather than manipulating model parameters directly (which fails on transformers due to tied embedding and LayerNorm feedback loops), RegionFed usesℓ2\ell_{2}梯度冲突是分层区域结构内自适应个性化的唯一信号。梯度级操作避免了不稳定，因为它们决定了gradient conflict as the sole signal for adaptive personalization within a hierarchical regional structure. Gradient-level operations avoid instability because they determine多少how much应用每个区域的标准梯度，无需注入通过共享权重矩阵传播的附加参数校正。这将模型视为可微分的黑匣子，从而无需修改代码即可跨架构（T5、RoBERTa 或未来设计）进行部署。 (2)of the standard gradient to apply per region, without injecting additive parameter corrections that propagate through shared weight matrices. This treats models as differentiable black boxes, enabling deployment across architectures (T5, RoBERTa, or future designs) without code modification. (2)计算感知策略编排Compute-aware strategy orchestration：梯度冲突信号充当自动分类系统，将每个区域路由到最便宜的充足策略（Grad/Interp/Meta），仅在冲突需要时才部署昂贵的元学习。 (3): the gradient-conflict signal serves as an automated triage system that routes each region to the cheapest sufficient strategy (Grad/Interp/Meta), deploying expensive meta-learning only when conflict warrants it. (3)具有具体隐私保证的 DP 兼容冲突检测DP-compatible conflict detection with concrete privacy guarantees: DP 梯度裁剪 (: DP gradient clipping (C=1.0C{=}1.0) 限制信号分量，而 sigmoid 则通过) bounds the signal component, while the sigmoid centering viaμr\mu_{r}（从第 1 轮校准）吸收噪声基线，确保(calibrated from round 1) absorbs the noise baseline, ensuring that亲戚relative冲突差异在各轮次和区域中仍然具有重要意义。与conflict differences remain informative across rounds and regions. Withσd​p=4.0\sigma_{dp}{=}4.0, T=50T{=}50, 和, andδ=10−5\delta{=}10^{-5}, RegionFed 实现, RegionFed achievesϵ≈0.60\epsilon\approx 0.60同时缩小与集中准确度的差距。 (4)while closing the gap to centralized accuracy. (4)理论和实证验证Theoretical and empirical validation: 𝒪⁡(1/T)\mathcal{O}(1/\sqrt{T})具有显式异质性依赖的收敛性（定理convergence with explicit heterogeneity dependence (Theorem5.1）； T5-Small 上的 FedAvg/FedProx 提高了 12–25pp；崩溃（); 12–25pp improvement over FedAvg/FedProx on T5-Small; collapse (<<10%）的所有四个参数级基线测试10%) of all four parameter-level baselines tested acrossE∈{1,5,10,40}E{\in}\{1,5,10,40\}关于变压器，通过 LEAF-FEMNIST 确认变压器特定on transformers, confirmed transformer-specific via LEAF-FEMNIST(Caldas et al., 2018)其中 SCAFFOLD 在 CNN 上获得了 79.52% 的支持率； RoBERTa-Base、T5-3B 和 CNN 的跨架构确认；亚马逊评论的跨域验证where SCAFFOLD achieves 79.52% on CNN; cross-architecture confirmation on RoBERTa-Base, T5-3B, and CNN; cross-domain validation on Amazon Reviews(Ni et al., 2019)（表(Table1，B组）； 50回合以上持续保持优势。所有结果平均超过 5 颗种子。, Panel B); sustained advantage over 50 rounds. 2 挑战和问题表述Challenges and Problem Formulation

联邦学习在数据异构性下收敛到次优解决方案：客户端漂移与梯度差异成比例地降低收敛性Federated learning converges to sub-optimal solutions under data heterogeneity: client drift degrades convergence proportionally to gradient dissimilarity(Karimireddy et al., 2020)，并且异构目标会产生不可约误差项, and heterogeneous objectives create an irreducible error term(Li et al., 2020)。零售搜索通过区域语义差异（“丁字裤”在澳大利亚指鞋类，但在美国指内衣）、不同的产品供应情况以及季节性/文化时间差异来放大这一点。单一的全球模型不可避免地会牺牲区域准确性，从而促进区域感知的个性化。. Retail search amplifies this through regional semantic differences (“thongs” means footwear in Australia but undergarments in the US), varying product availability, and seasonal/cultural timing differences. A single global model inevitably sacrifices regional accuracy, motivating region-aware personalization.

5.1 整体性能比较Overall Performance Comparison

表Table1呈现综合结果。 RegionFed-Meta 在集中训练的统计噪声范围内达到了 92.27%（91.72%，presents comprehensive results. RegionFed-Meta achieves 92.27%, within statistical noise of centralized training (91.72%,Δ\Delta=0.55pp，1以内=0.55pp, within 1σ\sigma），同时充分保留), while fully preserving(ϵ≈0.60,δ=10−5)(\epsilon{\approx}0.60,\delta{=}10^{-5})-DP。-DP.

发现 1：RegionFed 匹配集中培训。Finding 1: RegionFed Matches Centralized Training.RegionFed-Meta 达到 92.27RegionFed-Meta achieves 92.27±\pm总体准确度为 0.31%。为了正确地说明这一点，我们报告了两个集中的上限：（a）0.31% overall accuracy. To properly contextualize this, we report two centralized upper bounds: (a)集中式Centralized (91.72±\pm0.28%）：具有单一全球目标的汇总数据（侵犯隐私）； (二)0.28%): pooled data with a single global objective (privacy-violating); (b)集中+区域加权Centralized + Regional Weighting (92.04±\pm0.25%）：具有区域加权多任务损失的汇总数据，控制分层目标结构。 RegionFed-Meta 缩小了与更强上限的差距（92.27% vs 92.04%，0.25%): pooled data with region-weighted multi-task loss, which controls for the hierarchical objective structure. RegionFed-Meta closes the gap to the stronger upper bound (92.27% vs 92.04%,Δ\Delta=0.23pp，1以内=0.23pp, within 1σ\sigma），确认梯度冲突机制完全恢复了侵犯隐私上限的准确性。在亚马逊评论中，RegionFed-Meta (68.94%) 接近集中化 (70.21%)，在 FEMNIST 上则接近集中化 (85.21% vs 86.73%)。), confirming that the gradient-conflict mechanism fully recovers the privacy-violating upper bound’s accuracy. On Amazon Reviews, RegionFed-Meta (68.94%) approaches centralized (70.21%), and on FEMNIST (85.21% vs 86.73%).贡献分解：Contribution decomposition:仅区域结构（Reg-Aware FedAvg，83.47%）就比 FedAvg（80.18%）高出 3.29 个百分点；梯度冲突适应进一步增加了+8.80pp，达到 RF-Meta (92.27%)，占总增益 12.09pp 的 73%。Regional structure alone (Reg-Aware FedAvg, 83.47%) provides +3.29pp over FedAvg (80.18%); gradient-conflict adaptation adds a further +8.80pp to reach RF-Meta (92.27%), accounting for 73% of the total 12.09pp gain.

发现 2：标准 FL 方法是不够的。Finding 2: Standard FL Methods Are Insufficient.FedAvg (80.18%) 和 FedProx (67.18%) 比集中训练低 12-25 个百分点。 FedProx 的表现不如 FedAvg，因为它的近项对所有参数应用统一正则化（最好FedAvg (80.18%) and FedProx (67.18%) fall 12–25pp below centralized training. FedProx underperforms FedAvg because its proximal term applies uniform regularization to all parameters (bestμ=0.01\mu{=}0.01;在; atμ=0.001\mu{=}0.001FedProx 达到 78.4%，接近 FedAvg，但仍比 RegionFed 低 13.87 个百分点；见附录FedProx reaches 78.4%, approaching FedAvg but still 13.87pp below RegionFed; see AppendixC进行详细分析），防止必要的专业化：注意力头需要快速漂移以进行区域适应，而嵌入应保持稳定。for detailed analysis), preventing necessary specialization: attention heads require rapid drift for regional adaptation while embeddings should remain stable.

发现 3：参数级方法在 Transformer 上失败（独立于Finding 3: Parameter-Level Methods Fail on Transformers (Independent ofEE).SCAFFOLD、pFedMe、Ditto 和 APFL 全部崩溃为SCAFFOLD, pFedMe, Ditto, and APFL all collapse to<<T5-小号 10%。此故障在所有本地纪元设置中持续存在（10% on T5-Small. This failure persists across all local epoch settings (E∈{1,5,10,40}E{\in}\{1,5,10,40\};附录; AppendixF），确认它是基本的，而不是客户漂移的产物。控制消融（附录), confirming it is fundamental rather than an artifact of client drift. Controlled ablations (AppendixF.5）隔离根本原因：仅解开 T5 的共享嵌入即可将 SCAFFOLD 从 8.73% 恢复到 42.61%；冻结LayerNorm恢复到38.47%；两者相加，收益率为 71.83%。这表明绑定嵌入和 LayerNorm 是变压器参数级方法的主要不稳定源。) isolate the root cause: untying T5’s shared embeddings alone recovers SCAFFOLD from 8.73% to 42.61%; freezing LayerNorm recovers to 38.47%; combining both yields 71.83%. This demonstrates that tied embeddings and LayerNorm are the primary instability sources for parameter-level methods on transformers.

6 结论和局限性Conclusion and Limitations

RegionFed 通过梯度冲突而不是参数操作来个性化联邦学习，从而无需更改代码即可实现跨 Transformer 和 CNN 的稳健部署。当参数级校正崩溃时，梯度级操作保持稳定；受控烧蚀确认绑定嵌入和 LayerNorm 是不稳定源。在三个公共数据集和四种架构中，RegionFed 实现了 92.27%（在 1RegionFed personalizes federated learning via gradient conflict rather than parameter manipulation, enabling robust deployment across transformers and CNNs without code changes. Gradient-level operations remain stable where parameter-level corrections collapse; controlled ablations confirm tied embeddings and LayerNorm as the instability sources. Across three public datasets and four architectures, RegionFed achieves 92.27% (within 1σ\sigma集中化 92.04%）of centralized 92.04%) with(ϵ≈0.60)(\epsilon{\approx}0.60)-DP。-DP.

局限性。Limitations.(1) 需要预定义区域（自动发现是未来的工作；错误指定仅导致 4.2pp 损失）。 (2) 多模态任务和状态空间模型仍未得到评估。 （3）动态策略选择偶尔会出现误路（附录(1) Pre-defined regions required (automatic discovery is future work; misspecification incurs only 4.2pp loss). (2) Multimodal tasks and state-space models remain unevaluated. (3) Dynamic strategy selection occasionally misroutes (AppendixD.6）。见附录). See AppendixM以获得更广泛的影响和道德。for broader impact and ethics.

A.2 联邦学习方法的演变Evolution of Federated Learning Methods

第一代：全球模型方法（2017）。First Generation: Global Model Approaches (2017).美联储平均FedAvg[McMahan et al., 2017]建立了平均客户端更新的基本范例。这产生了无法适应区域异质性的单一全球模型。established the foundational paradigm of averaging client updates. This produces a single global model that cannot adapt to regional heterogeneity.

第二代：个性化 FL（2020-2021）。Second Generation: Personalized FL (2020-2021).联邦代理FedProx[Li et al., 2020]通过近端正则化解决客户漂移问题；脚手架addressed client drift through proximal regularization; SCAFFOLD[Karimireddy et al., 2020]引入控制变量以减少方差； pFedMeintroduced control variates for variance reduction; pFedMe[T. Dinh et al., 2020]应用莫罗信封进行双层个性化；每次喂食平均applied Moreau envelopes for bi-level personalization; Per-FedAvg[Fallah et al., 2020]将MAML与FL相结合以实现快速适应；美联储代表combined MAML with FL for fast adaptation; FedRep[Collins et al., 2021]分离的表示层和头层；联邦巴布separated representation and head layers; FedBABU[Oh et al., 2022]通过仅聚合身体并保持头部局部来简化层分割；亚太FLsimplified layer splitting by aggregating only the body and keeping the head local; APFL[Deng et al., 2020]提出局部和全局模型的自适应混合；同上proposed adaptive mixing of local and global models; Ditto[Li et al., 2021a]学习具有全局规范化局部目标的个性化模型；联邦BNlearned personalized models with a global-regularized local objective; FedBN[Li et al., 2021b]个性化的 BatchNorm 统计数据以处理跨客户端的功能转变；联邦新星personalized BatchNorm statistics to handle feature shift across clients; FedNova[Wang et al., 2020]通过标准化平均解决客观不一致问题。这些方法在 CNN（CIFAR-10、EMNIST）上取得了很好的结果，但运行速度较慢addressed objective inconsistency through normalized averaging. These methods achieved strong results on CNNs (CIFAR-10, EMNIST) but operate at the参数级别parameter level，限制了对变压器的适用性。, limiting applicability to transformers.

变压器特定的 FL 方法 (2023+)。Transformer-Specific FL Methods (2023+).最近的工作通过特定于架构的设计解决了变压器个性化问题：FedTPRecent work has addressed transformer personalization through architecture-specific designs: FedTP[Li et al., 2023]使用超网络生成个性化的注意力预测（uses hypernetworks to generate personalized attention projections (WQ,WK,WVW_{Q},W_{K},W_{V}）；联邦适配器); FedAdapter[Cai et al., 2023]插入可训练的适配器模块，以实现高效的 NLP 模型个性化；美联储LoRAinserts trainable adapter modules for efficient NLP model personalization; FedLoRA[Yi et al., 2023]应用低秩自适应来实现参数高效的联合微调。虽然这些方法对其目标架构有效，但需要applies low-rank adaptation for parameter-efficient federated fine-tuning. While effective for their target architectures, these methods require特定于架构的architecture-specific修改：FedTP必须知道注意机制结构，FedAdapter需要在特定位置插入适配器层，FedLoRA依赖于识别合适的层进行低秩分解。当模型架构频繁变化时（例如，从 T5 升级到 Llama，或部署 Mamba/RWKV 等非注意力架构），这限制了适用性。 RegionFed 的梯度水平方法是modifications: FedTP must know the attention mechanism structure, FedAdapter requires inserting adapter layers at specific positions, FedLoRA depends on identifying suitable layers for low-rank decomposition. This limits applicability when model architectures change frequently (e.g., upgrading from T5 to Llama, or deploying non-attention architectures like Mamba/RWKV). RegionFed’s gradient-level approach is架构稳健architecture-robust：它将模型视为可微分的黑匣子，无需修改代码即可无缝应用到任何架构。: it treats models as differentiable black boxes, enabling seamless application to any architecture without code modifications.

第三代：集群和分层FL（2020-2021）。Third Generation: Clustered and Hierarchical FL (2020-2021).节能灯CFL[Ghosh et al., 2020]基于梯度相似度对客户端进行聚类；簇状FLclusters clients based on gradient similarity; ClusteredFL[Sattler et al., 2021]提供与模型无关的分布式多任务优化；联邦新兴市场provides model-agnostic distributed multi-task optimization; FedEM[Marfoq et al., 2021]将客户数据建模为基础分布的混合。这些方法认识到中间聚合的需要，但每个集群生成单个模型，而没有细粒度的个性化机制。models client data as mixtures of underlying distributions. These approaches recognize the need for intermediate aggregation but produce single models per cluster without fine-grained personalization mechanisms.

最新进展（2022-2025）。Recent Developments (2022-2025).美联储原型FedProto[Tan et al., 2022]聚合类原型而不是异构客户端的模型权重； pFedHyperaggregates class prototypes rather than model weights for heterogeneous clients; pFedHyper[Zhang et al., 2024]使用超网络生成个性化模型参数。逐层梯度冲突分析uses hypernetworks to generate personalized model parameters. Layer-wise gradient conflict analysis[Sun et al., 2024]分解每层的冲突以实现更细粒度的适应。带有基础模型的黑盒 FLdecomposes conflicts per layer for finer-grained adaptation. Black-box FL with foundation models[Chen et al., 2025]探索大型预训练模型的联合微调，无需访问内部权重。虽然这些方法促进了个性化，但它们仍然是特定于体系结构的或在参数级别上运行。 RegionFed 的梯度级别方法在将架构稳健性与区域分层聚合相结合方面仍然是独一无二的。explores federated fine-tuning of large pre-trained models without access to internal weights. While these methods advance personalization, they remain either architecture-specific or operate at the parameter level. RegionFed’s gradient-level approach remains unique in combining architecture-robustness with regional hierarchical aggregation.

基线选择理由。Baseline Selection Rationale.我们针对 FedAvg、FedProx、SCAFFOLD、pFedMe、FedBABU、Ditto、APFL 和 FedTP 进行评估，因为它们代表了各自类别中的规范方法：(1) FedAvg/FedProx 用于全局模型方法，(2) SCAFFOLD 用于通过控制变量减少方差，(3) pFedMe 用于双层个性化，(4) FedBABUWe evaluate against FedAvg, FedProx, SCAFFOLD, pFedMe, FedBABU, Ditto, APFL, and FedTP as they represent the canonical methods in their respective categories: (1) FedAvg/FedProx for global model approaches, (2) SCAFFOLD for variance reduction via control variates, (3) pFedMe for bi-level personalization, (4) FedBABU[Oh et al., 2022]用于分层个性化（与本地头部的身体聚合），（5）用于本地全局混合的 Ditto/APFL，以及（6）FedTP 通过超网络用于变压器特定的个性化。 FedBABU 的信息量特别大，因为它避免了变压器上 SCAFFOLD/pFedMe/Ditto/APFL 的灾难性崩溃（达到 84.53% vsfor layer-splitting personalization (body aggregation with local head), (5) Ditto/APFL for local-global mixing, and (6) FedTP for transformer-specific personalization via hypernetworks. FedBABU is particularly informative because it avoids the catastrophic collapse of SCAFFOLD/pFedMe/Ditto/APFL on transformers (achieving 84.53% vs<<10%），将故障模式与参数级操作隔离，而不是 FL 设置本身（详细分析见第 1 节）10%), isolating the failure mode to parameter-level manipulation rather than the FL setting itself (detailed analysis in SectionF.7）。其他参数级方法（FedRep、FedNova、Per-FedAvg）也有相同的基本限制。我们的实验表明，RegionFed 达到了 92.27%，同时保持与架构无关，超越了崩溃的参数级方法和稳定但有限的 FedBABU 基线。). Other parameter-level methods (FedRep, FedNova, Per-FedAvg) share the same fundamental limitation. Our experiments demonstrate that RegionFed achieves 92.27% while remaining architecture-agnostic, surpassing both collapsing parameter-level methods and the stable but limited FedBABU baseline.

A.3 电子商务中的查询理解Query Understanding in E-commerce

电子商务中的现代查询理解系统面临五个关键挑战：(1)Modern query understanding systems in e-commerce face five key challenges: (1)隐私和敏感性Privacy and Sensitivity：用户搜索查询经常包含暴露私人健康状况或个人偏好的敏感术语，存在违反 GDPR/CCPA 的风险； (2): user search queries frequently include sensitive terms exposing private health conditions or personal preferences, risking GDPR/CCPA violations; (2)集中数据限制Centralized Data Limitations：上传大量原始查询数据会产生较高的带宽成本并限制实时反馈； (3): uploading large volumes of raw query data incurs high bandwidth costs and limits real-time feedback; (3)地区差异Regional Variance：不同地点的搜索行为有所不同（例如，“丁字裤”在澳大利亚指鞋类，但在美国指内衣）； (4): search behavior varies across locations (e.g., “thongs” refers to footwear in Australia but undergarments in the US); (4)缺乏设备上的个性化Lack of On-Device Personalization：用户意图取决于个人搜索历史，模型因隐私风险而避免这样做； (5): user intent depends on personal search histories that models avoid due to privacy risks; (5)缓慢的趋势适应Slow Trend Adaptation：像黑色星期五这样的事件会迅速改变查询分布，而集中式管道需要数周的时间进行重新训练。: events like Black Friday rapidly shift query distributions while centralized pipelines require weeks to retrain.

著名的系统包括大规模个性化推荐引擎Notable systems include large-scale personalized recommendation engines[Smith and Linden, 2017]，多粒度注意力机制, multi-grained attention mechanisms[Yang et al., 2017]，以及最近基于变压器的查询理解系统。这些通常利用集中式数据收集，加剧隐私挑战。, and recent transformer-based query understanding systems. These typically leverage centralized data collection that exacerbates privacy challenges.

A.4 个性化策略分类Personalization Strategies Taxonomy

我们根据 FL 个性化方法的不同对 FL 个性化方法进行分类We categorize FL personalization approaches by their操作水平operating level:

参数级方法Parameter-Level Methods直接操纵模型参数：manipulate model parameters directly:

  • •

    控制变量Control variates(SCAFFOLD)：维护特定于客户的修正向量(SCAFFOLD): Maintain client-specific correction vectorscic_{i}

  • •

    双层优化Bi-level optimization(pFedMe)：通过参数正则化解决嵌套优化问题(pFedMe): Solve nested optimization with parameter regularization

  • •

    归一化平均Normalized averaging(FedNova)：通过局部步骤标准化解决目标不一致问题(FedNova): Address objective inconsistency via local step normalization

  • •

    层分裂Layer splitting（FedRep、LG-FedAvg）：单独的共享/个人层(FedRep, LG-FedAvg): Separate shared/personal layers

这些方法假设直接参数访问和操作，由于变压器的共享嵌入和注意力耦合而变得不稳定。These methods assume direct parameter access and manipulation, becoming unstable with transformers’ shared embeddings and attention coupling.

梯度水平方法Gradient-Level Methods对计算的梯度进行操作：operate on computed gradients:

  • •

    梯度加权Gradient weighting：根据相似度调整客户端梯度的贡献: Adjust contribution of client gradients based on similarity

  • •

    梯度投影Gradient projection：投影梯度以减少冲突（PCGrad: Project gradients to reduce conflicts (PCGrad[Yu et al., 2020], CAGrad [Liu et al., 2021])

  • •

    RegionFed（这项工作）RegionFed (this work)：通过梯度冲突检测进行自适应区域个性化: Adaptive regional personalization via gradient conflict detection

梯度级方法本质上是与架构无关的，因为它们只需要梯度计算，而不需要参数结构知识。Gradient-level methods are inherently architecture-agnostic as they only require gradient computation, not parameter structure knowledge.

A.5 搜索系统中的隐私Privacy in Search Systems

搜索系统中的隐私问题已通过差异隐私得到解决Privacy concerns in search systems have been addressed through differential privacy[Dwork and Roth, 2014, Abadi et al., 2016]、安全聚合, secure aggregation[Bonawitz et al., 2017]，以及本地隐私, and local privacy[Wang et al., 2017]。最近的工作将差分隐私与 FL 结合起来，尽管隐私与效用的权衡对于个性化搜索来说仍然具有挑战性。. Recent work combines differential privacy with FL, though privacy-utility trade-offs remain challenging for personalized search.

据我们所知，之前的工作尚未探索过To our knowledge, no prior work has explored与架构无关architecture-agnostic使用变压器模型进行零售搜索的联邦学习。 RegionFed 通过提供基于梯度的个性化来填补这一空白，该个性化与现代神经架构无缝协作，同时保持理论收敛保证。federated learning for retail search with transformer models. RegionFed fills this gap by providing gradient-based personalization that works seamlessly with modern neural architectures while maintaining theoretical convergence guarantees.

B.1 亚马逊 ESCI（主要基准）Amazon ESCI (Primary Benchmark)

Amazon ESCI 是源自公共购物查询数据集的多任务查询理解基准Amazon ESCI is a multi-task query understanding benchmark derived from the public Shopping Queries Dataset[Reddy et al., 2022]（130,652 个唯一查询，260 万个查询-产品判断）。它通过受控的区域分区捕获联合零售搜索中的现实异质性。(130,652 unique queries, 2.6M query-product judgements). It captures realistic heterogeneity in federated retail search through controlled regional partitioning.

B.1.1 施工方法Construction Methodology

源数据。Source Data.从公共 ESCI 数据集中，我们提取了：（1）来自 97,345 个英语查询的句法查询模板； (2) 24类产品分类； (3) 相关性标签分布（精确/替代/补充/不相关）告知意图边界； (4) 180 万条产品描述中的实体类型（品牌、颜色、尺寸、材质）。From the public ESCI dataset, we extracted: (1) syntactic query templates from 97,345 English queries; (2) a 24-category product taxonomy; (3) relevance label distributions (Exact/Substitute/Complement/Irrelevant) informing intent boundaries; (4) entity types (brand, color, size, material) from 1.8M product descriptions.

区域异质性建模。Regional Heterogeneity Modeling.我们使用公开的零售行业报告和 ESCI 分布对 8 个人口统计区域的类别偏好进行建模：区域类别概率We modeled category preferences across 8 demographic regions using publicly available retail industry reports and ESCI distributions: regional category probabilitiesP⁡(category|region)P(\text{category}|\text{region})、每个类别前 1000 个查询词、字符级拼写错误分布（替换 60%、删除 20%、插入 20%；损坏率 15%）以及季节性查询量变化。, top-1000 query terms per category, character-level typo distributions (substitution 60%, deletion 20%, insertion 20%; 15% corruption rate), and seasonal query volume shifts.

验证。Validation.针对源 ESCI 数据集的分布统计证实了现实性：（1）分区分布和原始类别分布之间的 KL 散度：0.08； (2)查询长度分布重叠度：94.2%； (3)实体类型频率相关性：PearsonDistributional statistics against the source ESCI dataset confirm realism: (1) KL divergence between partitioned and original category distributions: 0.08; (2) query length distribution overlap: 94.2%; (3) entity type frequency correlation: Pearsonr=0.91r=0.91.

为什么要进行受控分区？Why Controlled Partitioning?任意用户划分（例如 IID 数据上的随机狄利克雷）会破坏语义区域相关性。我们的基准明确地构建了这些相关性，从而实现：跨研究组的再现性，通过狄利克雷控制异质性Arbitrary user partitioning (e.g., random Dirichlet on IID data) destroys semantic regional correlations. Our benchmark constructs these correlations explicitly, enabling: reproducibility across research groups, controlled heterogeneity via Dirichletα\alpha、隐私合规性（无真实用户数据）以及基于 ESCI 的经过验证的现实性。, privacy compliance (no real user data), and validated realism grounded in ESCI.

B.3 叶派女权主义者LEAF-FEMNIST

叶派女权主义者LEAF-FEMNIST[Caldas et al., 2018]通过自然异构（非合成）客户端分区验证视觉任务的架构不可知论，其中每个客户端对应于单个手写作者。validates architecture-agnosticism on a vision task with naturally heterogeneous (not synthetic) client partitioning, where each client corresponds to a single handwriting author.

数据集配置。Dataset Configuration.62级字符识别（10位数字+26个大写字母+26个小写字母）。从完整 LEAF 数据集中采样的 200 个客户，根据作者相似性（每个作者类别分布的成对余弦相似性、凝聚聚类）分为 10 个区域。每个区域包含 20 个客户。训练/测试划分遵循标准 LEAF 协议（每个客户端 90/10）。62-class character recognition (10 digits + 26 uppercase + 26 lowercase). 200 clients sampled from the full LEAF dataset, grouped into 10 regions by writer similarity (pairwise cosine similarity of per-writer class distributions, agglomerative clustering). Each region contains 20 clients. Train/test split follows the standard LEAF protocol (90/10 per client).

模型架构。Model Architecture.2-卷积 + 2-FC CNN：Conv(12-conv + 2-FC CNN: Conv(1→\to32, 5×\times5) →\to ReLU →\to最大池(2)MaxPool(2)→\to转化次数(32Conv(32→\to64, 5×\times5) →\to ReLU →\to最大池(2)MaxPool(2)→\to足球俱乐部(1600FC(1600→\to512) →\to ReLU →\to足球俱乐部(512FC(512→\to62）。总计：62). Total:∼{\sim}1.2M参数。1.2M parameters.

培训。Training. T=50T{=}50轮数，40 个本地 epoch，SGD 动量 0.9，rounds, 40 local epochs, SGD with momentum 0.9,η=0.01\eta{=}0.01, σd​p=4.0\sigma_{dp}{=}4.0, C=1.0C{=}1.0。 FedTP 被省略（需要变压器注意机制）。. FedTP is omitted (requires transformer attention mechanisms).

关键发现。Key Finding.SCAFFOLD 达到 79.52%（功能正常，未折叠），证实SCAFFOLD achieves 79.52% (functional, not collapsed), confirming that<<10% 的故障是变压器特定的。 Ditto (80.8%) 和 APFL (81.2%) 在 CNN 上也正常运行。 RegionFed-Meta 达到 85.21%，展示了跨架构的一致收益。10% failure is transformer-specific. Ditto (80.8%) and APFL (81.2%) also function normally on CNNs. RegionFed-Meta achieves 85.21%, demonstrating consistent gains across architectures.

C.2 发现 2：为什么标准 FL 方法不够充分Finding 2: Why Standard FL Methods Are Insufficient

由于处理异构数据的基本限制，FedAvg (80.18%) 和 FedProx (67.18%) 比集中训练低 12-25 个百分点。FedAvg (80.18%) and FedProx (67.18%) fall 12-25pp below centralized training due to fundamental limitations in handling heterogeneous data.

梯度冲突分析。Gradient Conflict Analysis.在异构 FL 中，区域梯度In heterogeneous FL, regional gradientsgr=∇ℒr​(θ)g_{r}=\nabla\mathcal{L}_{r}(\theta)指向相互矛盾的方向。 FedAvg 的简单平均：point in conflicting directions. FedAvg’s simple averaging:

ga​v​g=1M​∑r=1Mgrg_{avg}=\frac{1}{M}\sum_{r=1}^{M}g_{r} (11)

产生的折衷梯度对于所有区域来说可能不是最佳的。当produces a compromise gradient that may be suboptimal for all regions. When⟨gi,gj⟩<0\langle g_{i},g_{j}\rangle<0（负余弦相似度），平均部分取消了有用的梯度信息。(negative cosine similarity), averaging partially cancels useful gradient information.

为什么使用 L2 范数而不是余弦相似度？Why L2 Norm Instead of Cosine Similarity?虽然梯度冲突通常通过内积来定义（While gradient conflict is often defined via inner product (⟨gi,gj⟩<0\langle g_{i},g_{j}\rangle<0），RegionFed 使用 L2 距离进行自适应权重计算（方程), RegionFed uses L2 distance for adaptive weight computation (Equations6-7在主要论文中）因为：（1）in main paper) because: (1)幅度灵敏度Magnitude sensitivity：L2 捕获幅度和方向差异；一个区域有 10: L2 captures both magnitude and direction differences; a region with 10×\times即使方向一致，较大的梯度（更快的局部学习）也应该获得更高的个性化； (2)larger gradients (faster local learning) should receive higher personalization even if directions align; (2)实证验证Empirical validation：在我们的设置中，L2 与余弦相似度密切相关（Pearson: L2 correlates strongly with cosine similarity in our setting (Pearsonr=0.87r=0.87, 表, Table14); (3) 数值稳定性Numerical stability：对于接近零梯度，L2 比余弦相似度更稳定，这种情况发生在模型接近收敛的后期训练阶段。: L2 is more stable than cosine similarity for near-zero gradients, which occur during later training stages when the model approaches convergence.

为什么 FedProx 表现更差。Why FedProx Performs Worse.与直觉相反，FedProx (67.18%) 在 T5-Small 上的表现低于 FedAvg (80.18%)。最接近的术语：Counter-intuitively, FedProx (67.18%) underperforms FedAvg (80.18%) on T5-Small. The proximal term:

minθ⁡Fi​(θ)+μ2​‖θ−θt‖2\min_{\theta}F_{i}(\theta)+\frac{\mu}{2}\|\theta-\theta^{t}\|^{2} (12)

限制本地更新以保持接近全局模型。而每个参数的梯度constrains local updates to stay close to the global model. While the per-parameter gradientμ⁡(θi−θit)\mu(\theta_{i}-\theta_{i}^{t})与模型维数无关，失败的发生是因为均匀正则化强度is independent of model dimensionality, the failure arises because the uniform regularization strengthμ\mu无论其功能作用如何，都相同地应用于所有参数。在 Transformer 中，参数的漂移率差异很大：嵌入（27% 的参数）变化缓慢，而注意力头需要快速专业化。统一约束阻止了高漂移注意参数的必要专门化，同时与低漂移嵌入参数无关，产生比无约束 FedAvg 更糟糕的结果。is applied identically to all parameters regardless of their functional role. In transformers, parameters have vastly different drift rates: embeddings (27% of parameters) change slowly while attention heads require rapid specialization. The uniform constraint prevents necessary specialization of high-drift attention parameters while being irrelevant for low-drift embedding parameters, yielding worse results than unconstrained FedAvg.

C.3 发现 3：参数级方法与梯度级方法Finding 3: Parameter-Level vs Gradient-Level Methods

SCAFFOLD、pFedMe、Ditto 和 APFL 在 T5-Small 上的较差性能揭示了参数级个性化和梯度级个性化之间的根本区别。这些方法在其接口中与架构无关（在扁平参数向量上运行），但对变压器的高维参数景观特征的拓扑敏感。有关详细的故障模式分析，包括超参数稳定性研究，请参阅部分The poor performance of SCAFFOLD, pFedMe, Ditto, and APFL on T5-Small reveals a fundamental distinction between parameter-level and gradient-level personalization. These methods are architecture-agnostic in their interface (operating on flattened parameter vectors), but are sensitive to the topology of high-dimensional parameter landscapes characteristic of transformers. For detailed failure mode analysis including hyperparameter stability studies, see SectionF.

定义。Definition. 参数级Parameter-level方法通过控制变量、近端正则化或参数混合直接操纵模型参数。methods manipulate model parameters directly through control variates, proximal regularization, or parameter mixing.梯度级Gradient-level方法对优化信号（梯度冲突）进行操作，而不直接修改参数，使用冲突作为诊断和路由机制。methods operate on the optimization signal (gradient conflicts) without modifying parameters directly, using the conflict as a diagnostic and routing mechanism.

为什么架构很重要。Why Architecture Matters.现代变压器展示：Modern transformers exhibit:

  1. 1.

    共享嵌入Shared Embeddings：编码器-解码器共享词汇嵌入（16.4M/60.5M = 27% 的参数）。参数级修正不成比例地影响这些共享层。: Encoder-decoder share vocabulary embeddings (16.4M/60.5M = 27% of parameters). Parameter-level corrections disproportionately affect these shared layers.

  2. 2.

    注意耦合Attention Coupling：Q、K、V 预测通过注意力分数耦合。在没有相应 K/V 调整的情况下校正 Q 会产生不一致的表示。: Q, K, V projections are coupled through attention scores. Correcting Q without corresponding K/V adjustments creates inconsistent representations.

  3. 3.

    层归一化Layer Normalization：Transformers 使用 LayerNorm 标准化每层的激活。参数扰动会不可预测地放大或减弱。: Transformers use LayerNorm which normalizes activations per-layer. Parameter perturbations are amplified or dampened unpredictably.

局部微调成功。Local Fine-tuning Success.局部微调通过纯粹在梯度级别上操作，仅通过共享初始化来训练局部模型，实现了 88.84%。这验证了梯度级操作与架构无关，但客户端级个性化 (RRS=79.53%) 缺乏足够的数据来实现稳健的区域模式。Local Fine-tuning achieves 88.84% by operating purely at the gradient level, simply training local models from shared initialization. This validates that gradient-level operations are architecture-agnostic, but client-level personalization (RRS=79.53%) lacks sufficient data for robust regional patterns.

RegionFed 的区域方法 (RRS=91.62%) 大大优于客户端级本地微调 (RRS=79.53%)，尽管两者都使用梯度级别操作。RegionFed’s regional approach (RRS=91.62%) substantially outperforms client-level Local Fine-tuning (RRS=79.53%) despite both using gradient-level operations.

D.6 动态策略失败分析：根本原因和改进建议Dynamic Strategy Failure Analysis: Root Cause and Proposed Improvements

案例研究揭示了一个严重的异常现象：The case studies reveal a critical anomaly:动态策略仅实现 78.2% 的杂货意向Dynamic strategy achieves only 78.2% in Grocery intent，比 Grad（91.1%，差距 12.9%）、Meta（91.0%，差距 12.8%）甚至全球基线（85.5%，差距 7.3%）差很多。本节提供详细的根本原因分析，并提出策略选择机制的改进建议。, substantially worse than Grad (91.1%, 12.9% gap), Meta (91.0%, 12.8% gap), and even the global baseline (85.5%, 7.3% gap). This section provides detailed root cause analysis and proposes improvements to the strategy selection mechanism.

根本原因分析：滞后问题。Root Cause Analysis: The Hysteresis Problem.对训练日志的分析揭示了各轮通信中的失败模式：Analysis of training logs reveals the failure pattern across communication rounds:

杂货店失败的原因：Why Grocery Fails:杂货区域表现出与其他零售类别显着不同的独特查询模式（必需品、食品）。第1轮，高梯度冲突正确触发The Grocery region exhibits distinct query patterns (essential items, food products) that differ significantly from other retail categories. In Round 1, high gradient conflict correctly triggers毕业生grad策略。然而，随着全球模型的改进，strategy. However, as the global model improves, the明显的apparent冲突减少到阈值以下conflict decreases below thresholdτ=0.5\tau=0.5, 触发, triggering插值interp。这种对全局模型的插值. 对策略选择的改进建议。Proposed Improvements to Strategy Selection.我们确定了三个增强功能来防止灾难性的错误选择：We identify three enhancements to prevent catastrophic misselection:

(1) 性能感知回退(1) Performance-Aware Fallback：跟踪每个区域的验证准确性，并在准确性下降时切换到 Grad（安全默认值，一致性为 90.28%-93.06%）: Track validation accuracy per region and switch to Grad (safe default with 90.28%-93.06% consistency) when accuracy drops>5%>5\%从上一轮开始：from previous round:

生产建议。Production Recommendations.杂货店异常表明，没有验证保障的自动化可能会导致比全球基线更糟糕的结果。对于部署动态策略的生产系统：The Grocery anomaly demonstrates that automation without validation safeguards can lead to worse outcomes than the global baseline. For production systems deploying Dynamic strategy:

  1. 1.

    必填Required：实时精度监控，自动回退到 Grad: Real-time accuracy monitoring with automatic fallback to Grad

  2. 2.

    推荐Recommended：基于动量的冲突估计（: Momentum-based conflict estimation (β≥0.8\beta\geq 0.8）以防止振荡) to prevent oscillations

  3. 3.

    可选Optional：对无法进行按区域调整的关键应用程序进行整体投票: Ensemble voting for critical applications where per-region tuning is infeasible

这些发现强调了一个基本的权衡：动态策略减少了手动调整负担，但需要强大的监控基础设施来检测和减轻生产部署中的灾难性错误选择。These findings highlight a fundamental tradeoff: Dynamic strategy reduces manual tuning burden but requires robust monitoring infrastructure to detect and mitigate catastrophic misselection in production deployments.

为了超越非正式解释并确定哪个变压器组件导致参数级崩溃，我们在四个受控 T5-Small 变体上运行 SCAFFOLD，一次修改一个架构特征，同时保持所有其他设置相同（50 轮，To move beyond informal explanations and identify which transformer component causes parameter-level collapse, we run SCAFFOLD on four controlled T5-Small variants, modifying one architectural feature at a time while keeping all other settings identical (50 rounds,E=40E{=}40，亚当W，, AdamW,η=10−4\eta{=}10^{-4}，亚马逊 ESCI）：, Amazon ESCI):

解绑嵌入 (Untied embeddings (tie_word_embeddings=False) 42.61% 79.84%
冻结 LayerNorm（所有 LN 参数均已修复）Frozen LayerNorm (all LN params fixed) 38.47% 78.92%

主要发现。Key findings.(1) 仅解开嵌入即可将 SCAFFOLD 恢复至 42.61% (+33.9pp)，确认共享编码器-解码器嵌入是(1) Untying embeddings alone recovers SCAFFOLD to 42.61% (+33.9pp), confirming that shared encoder-decoder embeddings are the小学primary不稳定来源：控制变量将编码和解码嵌入推向冲突的方向。 (2) 仅冻结 LayerNorm 就恢复到 38.47% (+29.7pp)，证实 LayerNorm 的缩放/移位参数放大了跨层的控制变量误差。 (3) 结合这两个修复将 SCAFFOLD 恢复到 71.83%，接近 FedAvg（在相同约束架构下为 78.15%）。剩余的 6.3pp 差距可归因于注意力耦合（Q/K/V 相互依赖性）。 (4) 将 SCAFFOLD 限制为仅 LoRA 更新（等级 4，参数的 0.3%）达到 76.24%，进一步证实故障与耦合变压器组件的全参数更新有关。instability source: control variates push encoding and decoding embeddings in conflicting directions. (2) Freezing LayerNorm alone recovers to 38.47% (+29.7pp), confirming that LayerNorm’s scale/shift parameters amplify control-variate errors across layers. (3) Combining both fixes recovers SCAFFOLD to 71.83%, approaching FedAvg (78.15% under the same constrained architecture). The residual 6.3pp gap is attributable to attention coupling (Q/K/V interdependencies). (4) Restricting SCAFFOLD to LoRA-only updates (rank-4, 0.3% of parameters) achieves 76.24%, further confirming that the failure is tied to full-parameter updates on coupled transformer components.

这些受控实验将非正式假设（“共享嵌入和 LayerNorm 导致崩溃”）转变为经过验证的发现。 RegionFed 的梯度级设计避免了所有三种故障模式，因为梯度差信号These controlled experiments transform the informal hypothesis (“shared embeddings and LayerNorm cause collapse”) into a verified finding. RegionFed’s gradient-level design avoids all three failure modes because the gradient-difference signal∇ℒr−∇ℒ\nabla\mathcal{L}_{r}-\nabla\mathcal{L}被计算为单个向量运算，不与参数结构、绑定或归一化层交互。is computed as a single vector operation that does not interact with parameter structure, tying, or normalization layers.

F.6 FedTP：特定于 Transformer 的基线比较FedTP: Transformer-Specific Baseline Comparison

与完全失败的 SCAFFOLD/pFedMe 不同，FedTPUnlike SCAFFOLD/pFedMe which fail completely, FedTP[Li et al., 2023]是一种 Transformer 特有的个性化方法，在 T5-Small 上实现了具有竞争力的性能。我们提供详细的比较，以了解特定于架构的方法和与架构无关的方法之间的权衡。, a transformer-specific personalization method, achieves competitive performance on T5-Small. We provide detailed comparison to understand the trade-offs between architecture-specific and architecture-agnostic approaches.

Given a client embeddingec∈ℝ64e_{c}\in\mathbb{R}^{64}，超网络生成低阶适应, the hypernetwork generates low-rank adaptationsΔ​WQ,Δ​WK,Δ​WV\Delta W_{Q},\Delta W_{K},\Delta W_{V}对于每个变压器层的注意力预测。我们实施了 FedTP 以下for each transformer layer’s attention projections. F.7 FedBABU：分层基线分析FedBABU: Layer-Splitting Baseline Analysis

联邦巴布FedBABU[Oh et al., 2022]代表个性化 FL 的分层方法：模型主体（共享表示层）像 FedAvg 一样在全局聚合，而分类器头在本地训练并且从不进行通信。这避免了导致 SCAFFOLD/pFedMe/Ditto/APFL 在变压器上崩溃的参数级不稳定性，因为主体聚合与稳定的 FedAvg 相同，并且头部与跨客户端干扰隔离。represents a layer-splitting approach to personalized FL: the model body (shared representation layers) is aggregated globally like FedAvg, while the classifier head is trained locally and never communicated. This avoids the parameter-level instabilities that cause SCAFFOLD/pFedMe/Ditto/APFL to collapse on transformers, since the body aggregation is identical to stable FedAvg and the head is isolated from cross-client interference.

T5-Small 上的实现。Implementation on T5-Small.对于 T5 的编码器-解码器架构，我们将主体定义为所有 Transformer 层（编码器 + 解码器，For T5’s encoder-decoder architecture, we define the body as all transformer layers (encoder + decoder,∼\sim44M参数）和head作为语言模型投影层（44M parameters) and the head as the language model projection layer (流媒体头lm_head, ∼\sim16.4M 参数，与输入嵌入相关）。本地训练时，只更新头部；每一轮之后，身体都会被冻结并在全球范围内聚合。我们在 FedBABU 训练期间将头部与输入嵌入解开，以允许独立的个性化。16.4M parameters, tied with input embeddings). During local training, only the head is updated; the body is frozen and aggregated globally after each round. We untie the head from input embeddings during FedBABU training to allow independent personalization.

结果摘要。Results Summary.FedBABU 在 T5-Small (Amazon ESCI) 上的总体准确率达到 84.53%，介于 FedAvg (80.18%) 和 RegionFed-Meta (92.27%) 之间。它避免了 SCAFFOLD (8.73%)、pFedMe (0%)、Ditto (8.92%) 和 APFL (9.15%) 中出现的灾难性崩溃，证实崩溃是由参数级操作引起的（控制变量、莫罗包络、FedBABU achieves 84.53% overall accuracy on T5-Small (Amazon ESCI), placing it between FedAvg (80.18%) and RegionFed-Meta (92.27%). It avoids the catastrophic collapse seen in SCAFFOLD (8.73%), pFedMe (0%), Ditto (8.92%), and APFL (9.15%), confirming that the collapse is caused by parameter-level manipulation (control variates, Moreau envelopes,ℓ2\ell_{2}正则化）而不是 FL 设置本身。regularization) rather than the FL setting itself.

为什么 FedBABU 的表现不如 RegionFed。Why FedBABU Underperforms RegionFed.

  1. 1.

附录KAppendix K补充算法和扩展Supplementary Algorithms and Extensions

本节介绍辅助算法、额外的验证实验和未来的研究方向。This section presents auxiliary algorithms, additional validation experiments, and future research directions.

K.1 基于拓扑的模型相似度分析Topology-Based Model Similarity Analysis

评估区域模型之间的性能相似性对于基于适应的个性化至关重要。然而，由于神经网络的高维性和非线性特征，它并不平凡。模型参数之间的欧几里得距离或余弦相似度等标准指标不能保证与性能的相关性Evaluating performance similarity between regional models is essential for adaptation-based personalization. However, it is non-trivial due to high dimensionality and non-linear features of neural networks. Standard metrics like Euclidean distance or cosine similarity among model parameters don’t guarantee correlation with performance[Kornblith et al., 2019].

我们的解决方案利用拓扑，即表示空间中数据点的相邻性Our solution leverages topology, i.e., the adjacency of data points in the representation space[McNeill and Vijayakumar, 2015]，根据查询样本之间的相似性构建邻域关系图。关键思想是通过模型对表示为拓扑结构的共享测试输入集的反应来分析模型的知识。, to construct a neighborhood relationship graph based on the similarity between query samples. The key idea is to analyze a model’s knowledge through its reaction to a shared set of test inputs represented as a topological structure.

K.1.1 邻域图构建Neighborhood Graph Construction

构建邻域图To construct the neighborhood graphGG，我们定义：, we define:

  • •

    要点：Points:查询表示（来自编码器的嵌入）Query representations (embeddings from the encoder)

  • •

    边缘：Edges:基于语义相似性的查询之间的关系Relationships between queries based on semantic similarity

  • •

    边权重：Edge Weights:查询表示之间的相似度分数Similarity scores between query representations

我们使用基于余弦相似度的亲和度度量对条件概率分布进行建模：We model the conditional probability distribution with a cosine similarity-based affinity metric:

G={pi|j|pi|j=(2−(di​j−ρj))∑k=1,k≠jN(2−(dj​k−ρj)),0<i,j≤N}G=\{p_{i|j}|p_{i|j}=\frac{(2-(d_{ij}-\rho_{j}))}{\sum_{k=1,k\neq j}^{N}(2-(d_{jk}-\rho_{j}))},0<i,j\leq N\} (29)

其中：where:

  • •

    pi|jp_{i|j}：条件概率: conditional probability that theii-th 查询是的邻居-th query is the neighbor of thejj特征空间中的第一个查询-th query in the feature space ofGG

  • •

    ρj\rho_{j}： 之间的距离: distance between thejj第-个数据点及其最近邻点-th data point and its nearest neighbor

  • •

    di​jd_{ij}：查询嵌入之间的余弦距离: cosine distance between the embeddings of queriesii和andjj: di​j=1−⟨ei,ej⟩‖ei‖2​‖ej‖2d_{ij}=1-\frac{\langle e_{i},e_{j}\rangle}{\|e_{i}\|_{2}\|e_{j}\|_{2}}

  • •

    NN：验证集中的查询数: number of queries in the validation set

通过减去By subtractingρj\rho_{j}，我们确保流形的局部连通性，避免孤立点，从而更好地保留全局结构, we ensure local connectivity of the manifold, avoiding isolated points and thereby better preserving the global structure[McNeill and Vijayakumar, 2015].

K.1.2 跨区域知识转移损失Cross-Region Knowledge Transfer Loss

在跨区域调整模型时，我们希望确保捕获特定区域的知识，同时仍保持全球性能。我们使用区域模型和全局模型之间的拓扑关系来指导适应过程：When adapting models across regions, we want to ensure that region-specific knowledge is captured while still maintaining global performance. We use the topological relationship between regional and global models to guide the adaptation process:

ℒt​o​p​o=𝔼(q,c)∈𝒟v​a​l​[S⁡(Gg​l​o​b​a​l,Gr)]\mathcal{L}_{topo}=\mathbb{E}_{(q,c)\in\mathcal{D}_{val}}[S(G_{global},G_{r})] (30)

其中：where:

  • •

    Gg​l​o​b​a​lG_{global}：从全局模型嵌入构建的邻域图: neighborhood graph constructed from global model embeddings

  • •

    GrG_{r}：从区域模型嵌入构建的邻域图: neighborhood graph constructed from regional model embeddings

  • •

    S⁡(⋅,⋅)S(\cdot,\cdot)：两个图之间的相似性度量: similarity measure between two graphs

  • •

    𝒟v​a​l\mathcal{D}_{val}：带有查询的验证集: validation set with queriesqq和背景and contextscc

衡量相似度To measure the similarity ofGg​l​o​b​a​lG_{global}和andGrG_{r}在捕获灵活的关系时，我们采用交叉熵损失。考虑它们各自的条件概率in capturing flexible relationships, we employ cross-entropy loss. Considering their respective conditional probabilitiespi|jp_{i|j}（全球）和(global) andqi|jq_{i|j}（区域）：(regional):

ℒt​o​p​o=C​E​(Gg​l​o​b​a​l,Gr)=∑i∑j[pi|j​log⁡pi|jqi|j+(1−pi|j)​log⁡1−pi|j1−qi|j]\mathcal{L}_{topo}=CE(G_{global},G_{r})=\sum_{i}\sum_{j}\left[p_{i|j}\log\frac{p_{i|j}}{q_{i|j}}+(1-p_{i|j})\log\frac{1-p_{i|j}}{1-q_{i|j}}\right] (31)

这可以使用 KL 散度来简化：This can be simplified using KL divergence:

ℒt​o​p​o=∑jKL(Pj∥Qj)\mathcal{L}_{topo}=\sum_{j}\text{KL}(P_{j}\|Q_{j}) (32)

哪里wherePj=(p1|j,p2|j,…,pN|j)P_{j}=(p_{1|j},p_{2|j},\ldots,p_{N|j})和andQj=(q1|j,q2|j,…,qN|j)Q_{j}=(q_{1|j},q_{2|j},\ldots,q_{N|j})是查询的邻居的概率分布are the probability distributions over neighbors for queryjj.

K.1.4 实验分析Experimental Analysis

在我们的实验中，我们发现：In our experiments, we find that:

当拓扑丢失有益时：When topology loss is beneficial:

黄金分割搜索算法优化适应强度The golden section search algorithm optimizes the adaptation intensityρ\rho对于每个区域，不需要梯度计算。这种无导数优化方法特别适合当目标函数for each region without requiring gradient computation. K.3 跨架构和跨规模验证Cross-Architecture and Cross-Scale Validation

为了验证 RegionFed 的梯度级个性化确实与架构无关，我们在没有任何算法修改的情况下对另外两个主干进行了评估。To validate that RegionFed’s gradient-level personalization is truly architecture-agnostic, we evaluated on two additional backbones without any algorithmic modification.

跨架构：RoBERTa-Base（125M 参数）。Cross-Architecture: RoBERTa-Base (125M parameters).我们使用仅编码器的 RoBERTa-Base 主干网在意图分类任务上评估了 RegionFed-Grad 与 FedAvg。 FedAvg 的准确率达到 81.2%，而 RegionFed-Grad 的准确率达到 91.5%，提高了 10.3 个百分点，这证实了梯度冲突个性化在仅编码器架构上无缝运行，无需特定于架构的适配器。We evaluated RegionFed-Grad versus FedAvg on the intent classification task using an encoder-only RoBERTa-Base backbone. FedAvg achieved 81.2% accuracy, while RegionFed-Grad achieved 91.5%, a 10.3pp improvement, confirming that gradient-conflict personalization operates seamlessly on encoder-only architectures without architecture-specific adapters.

跨规模：T5-3B（30 亿个参数）。Cross-Scale: T5-3B (3 billion parameters).我们将骨干网从 T5-Small (60.5M) 扩展到 T5-3B。 RegionFed-Meta 的总体准确率达到 94.12%，比我们的 T5-Small 结果 (92.27%) 提高了 1.85 个百分点。因为自适应加权依赖于We scaled the backbone from T5-Small (60.5M) to T5-3B. RegionFed-Meta achieved 94.12% overall accuracy, a +1.85pp improvement over our T5-Small results (92.27%). Because the adaptive weighting relies on𝒪⁡(1)\mathcal{O}(1)梯度范数的标量投影（受 DP 裁剪限制）scalar projections of gradient norms (bounded by DP clippingCC），个性化机制的计算开销相对于基础训练成本保持不变。这证实了 RegionFed 可以有效地扩展到十亿参数模型。), the computational overhead of the personalization mechanism remained constant relative to the base training cost. This confirms that RegionFed scales efficiently to billion-parameter models.

这些结果表明，RegionFed 的梯度级操作确实与架构无关：相同的算法，具有相同的个性化机制超参数，可以泛化到纯编码器 (RoBERTa) 和编码器-解码器 (T5) 架构，以及模型规模的两个数量级（60.5M 到 3B 参数）。These results demonstrate that RegionFed’s gradient-level operations are genuinely architecture-agnostic: the same algorithm, with identical hyperparameters for the personalization mechanism, generalizes across encoder-only (RoBERTa) and encoder-decoder (T5) architectures, and across two orders of magnitude in model scale (60.5M to 3B parameters).

K.4 异步联合操作Asynchronous Federated Operations

RegionFed 当前的实现使用同步通信轮次（算法RegionFed’s current implementation uses synchronous communication rounds (Algorithm2），全局服务器在更新之前等待所有区域。本节讨论生产部署的异步操作的扩展。), where the global server waits for all regions before updating. This section discusses the extension to asynchronous operation for production deployment.

异步区域更新。Asynchronous Regional Updates.在生产中，区域可能具有不同的计算速度和网络延迟。 RegionFed 通过允许区域独立提交梯度更新来支持异步操作：In production, regions may have varying compute speeds and network latency. RegionFed supports asynchronous operation by allowing regions to submit gradient updates independently:

生产注意事项。Production Considerations. (1) 心跳协议Heartbeat protocol：区域发送周期性的心跳；如果一个区域连续错过 3 轮，服务器将不继续进行。 (2): regions send periodic heartbeats; if a region misses 3 consecutive rounds, the server proceeds without it. (2)梯度缓存Gradient caching：区域缓存其最新梯度，以便在重新连接时立即参与。 (3): regions cache their latest gradient to enable immediate participation when reconnecting. (3)自适应回合持续时间Adaptive round duration：服务器根据最快的情况调整回合持续时间: the server adjusts round duration based on the fastestpp区域百分比（默认% of regions (defaultp=80p=80），平衡新鲜度和参与度。对真实网络条件的全面异步评估仍然是未来的工作。), balancing freshness and participation. Full asynchronous evaluation with real-world network conditions remains future work.

K.5 未来的方向和扩展Future Directions and Extensions

本节讨论由我们的发现推动的扩展和未来的研究方向。This section discusses extensions and future research directions motivated by our findings.

K.5.1 自动区域发现Automatic Region Discovery

当前的 RegionFed 实施需要预先定义的区域边界。我们概述了一种用于自动区域发现的基于梯度的聚类方法：The current RegionFed implementation requires pre-defined regional boundaries. We outline a gradient-based clustering approach for automatic region discovery:

提议的算法：Proposed Algorithm:(1) 以随机区域分配进行初始化； (2) 计算梯度相似度矩阵(1) Initialize with random regional assignments; (2) Compute gradient similarity matrixSi​j=cos⁡(∇ℒi,∇ℒj)S_{ij}=\cos(\nabla\mathcal{L}_{i},\nabla\mathcal{L}_{j})跨客户； (3) 应用谱聚类across clients; (3) Apply spectral clustering onSS识别to identifyKK自然分组； (4)基于聚类更新区域边界； (5) 迭代直至收敛。关键的见解是具有相似梯度方向的客户端应该位于同一区域，因为它们共享相似的数据分布。natural groupings; (4) Update regional boundaries based on clustering; (5) Iterate until convergence. The key insight is that clients with similar gradient directions should be in the same region, as they share similar data distributions.

RegionFed 在两个级别应用差异隐私：(1) 每个区域内的用户级隐私，以及 (2) 用于全局聚合的区域级隐私。我们用矩会计师法分析隐私保障RegionFed applies differential privacy at two levels: (1) user-level privacy within each region, and (2) region-level privacy for global aggregation. By the差分隐私的后处理特性post-processing property of differential privacy [Dwork and Roth, 2014]，对差分隐私机制的输出执行的任何计算（不访问额外的隐私数据）不会消耗额外的隐私预算。正式：, any computation performed on the output of a differentially private mechanism (without accessing additional private data) does not consume additional privacy budget. 局限性。Limitations.(1) RegionFed需要预先定义区域；通过梯度聚类自动发现是未来的工作，尽管错误指定实验显示仅 4.2pp 退化（附录(1) RegionFed requires pre-defined regions; automatic discovery via gradient clustering is future work, though misspecification experiments show only 4.2pp degradation (AppendixG.4）。 (2) 我们在 NLP（T5、RoBERTa）和视觉（FEMNIST CNN）任务上进行验证；多模式任务和新兴架构（Mamba、状态空间模型）仍然是未来的工作。 (3) Amazon ESCI 和 Amazon Reviews 源自亚马逊数据； LEAF-FEMNIST 提供独立验证，但额外的特定领域基准（例如医学 FL）将进一步强化主张。 (4) 动态策略偶尔会失败（Grocery 78.2%）；我们推荐 Grad 作为生产默认值。 (5) 虽然我们在五点提供隐私效用分析). (2) We validate on NLP (T5, RoBERTa) and vision (FEMNIST CNN) tasks; multimodal tasks and emerging architectures (Mamba, state-space models) remain future work. (3) Amazon ESCI and Amazon Reviews derive from Amazon data; LEAF-FEMNIST provides independent validation, but additional domain-specific benchmarks (e.g., medical FL) would further strengthen claims. 更广泛的影响和道德。Broader Impact and Ethics.RegionFed 通过将用户数据保存在本地设备上来增强隐私性，并通过区域个性化促进公平的人工智能，确保跨地区的服务质量具有可比性。如果在没有公平审计的情况下部署，潜在的风险包括区域偏见放大和歧视性定价。我们建议在部署时进行持续的公平性监控。RegionFed enhances privacy by keeping user data on local devices and promotes equitable AI through regional personalization ensuring comparable service quality across regions. Potential risks include regional bias amplification and discriminatory pricing if deployed without fairness auditing. We recommend deployment with continuous fairness monitoring.
